items.prompt: A black and white line drawing features the text "{argument name="quote" default="DOING MY BEST RESULTS MAY VARY"}" in large, bold, bubble-style lettering. The text is surrounded by various cute and whimsical elements, including smiling stars, a cat face, clouds, daisies, hearts, cupcakes, a boba tea, and sparkly starbursts. The overall composition is dense and playful, designed as a coloring page.
